title: 第2572章 改造地球第2571章 你儿子长得还真像我
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
吃过晚饭。
丘意就在陈玉的督促下，跑到练功房里练功了。
因为练功房被占，丘凌风只能带着千星阁阁主去其他地方修炼。
“走吧，去别墅区，还有，今晚你就住我以前的房间吧。”
千星阁阁主朝着丘凌风说道。
在千星阁阁主的带领下，丘凌风来到了新城别墅区。
丘凌风看着千星阁阁主将自己领到门牌号001的别墅前时，还有些懵逼。
“你以前住这？”
丘凌风指着眼前的别墅问道。
“这是小月的房子，里面就有现成的练功房。”千星阁阁主说道。
“这还是司空月寒的房子？没想到她这么深藏不露。”丘凌风惊讶的说道。
刚从玄关走进客厅，丘凌风就看到那张真皮沙发上躺着一个形象略显邋遢，正在用手机打着游戏的女子。
“咳咳！”
千星阁阁主轻咳一声。
那女子立即放下手机，坐起身来，看到千星阁阁主的时候还有些惊讶：“你怎么来了？”
“这位又是？”
接着，她也和其他人一样，好奇起了丘凌风的身份。
“他叫洛雪，我朋友。”
“我今天过来只是想用练功房的，瑶玲，你好歹注意点形象嘛。”
丘凌风看着安瑶玲，忍不住说道。

“嘿嘿，反正你又不会嫌弃我。”
安瑶玲嘿嘿一笑，继续打起了手机游戏。
“没想到安瑶玲学妹还是个网瘾少女，不过……为什么司空月寒的房子里会有她的身影？”
丘凌风看着依旧沉迷手机游戏的安瑶玲，十分意外的说道。
“瑶玲的妈妈是小月请的住家保姆，所以她也顺势住了进来。”
千星阁阁主解释了一句，指了指二楼道，“别墅的练功房在二楼，你跟我来吧。”
说着，千星阁阁主就带着丘凌风走上二楼，来到了练功房。
在练功房里，丘凌风如法炮制，构建出了星天殿，供千星阁阁主修炼《魂源星易功》。
虽然如今的千星阁阁主已经入门了《魂源星易功》，但是在星天殿这种星辰之力充沛的环境下修炼，进境才会更加快。
丘凌风也不确定自己能够在这里待多久，自然是能让千星阁阁主越快修炼到更高境界越好。
……
亘荒界。
万法仙域，千空秘境外。
content_en:
Had dinner.
Under Chen Yu's urging, Qiu Yi ran to the practice room to practice.
Because the practice room was occupied, Qiu Lingfeng could only take the master of Qianxing Pavilion to practice elsewhere.
"Let's go to the villa area. Also, you can stay in my old room tonight."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion said to Qiu Lingfeng.
Under the leadership of the master of Qianxing Pavilion, Qiu Lingfeng came to the Xincheng villa area.
Qiu Lingfeng was still a little confused when he watched the master of Qianxing Pavilion lead him to the villa with house number 001.
"Did you live here before?"
Qiu Lingfeng asked, pointing to the villa in front of him.
"This is Xiaoyue's house, and there is a ready-made practice room inside." The master of Qianxing Pavilion said.
"Is this still Sikong Yuehan's house? I didn't expect her to be so secretive." Qiu Lingfeng said in surprise.
As soon as he walked into the living room from the entrance, Qiu Lingfeng saw a slightly slovenly woman lying on the leather sofa, playing games on her mobile phone.
"Ahem!"
The master of Qianxing Pavilion coughed lightly.
The woman immediately put down her phone and sat up. She was a little surprised when she saw the master of Qianxing Pavilion: "Why are you here?"
"Who is this again?"
Then, like everyone else, she became curious about Qiu Lingfeng's identity.
"His name is Luo Xue, my friend."
"I came here today just to use the practice room. Yao Ling, please pay attention to your image."
Qiu Lingfeng looked at An Yaoling and couldn't help but say.
"Hey, you won't dislike me anyway."
An Yaoling smiled and continued playing the mobile game.
"I didn't expect that senior An Yaoling is still an Internet addict, but...why is she in Sikong Yuehan's house?"
Qiu Lingfeng looked at An Yaoling who was still addicted to mobile games and said in surprise.
"Yao Ling's mother was the live-in nanny hired by Xiao Yue, so she took advantage of the situation and moved in."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion explained, pointed to the second floor and said, "The practice room of the villa is on the second floor. Come with me."
With that said, the master of Qianxing Pavilion took Qiu Lingfeng up to the second floor and came to the practice room.
In the practice room, Qiu Lingfeng followed the same method and built the Xingtian Palace for the master of Qianxing Pavilion to practice the "Soul Source Star Yi Gong".
Although the current Pavilion Master of Qianxing Pavilion has already learned the "Soul Source Star Yi Gong", his progress will be faster if he practices in an environment rich in star power like Xingtian Palace.
Qiu Lingfeng is not sure how long he can stay here. Naturally, the sooner the master of Qianxing Pavilion can cultivate to a higher level, the better.
…
The world of eternity.
The Immortal Realm of Ten Thousand Dharmas, outside the Secret Realm of Thousand Sky.
